items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: That was Bill Brady's band... I was playing trombone. Bill Brady was playing piano.

ctx.x: Did he read all of his stuff? No, not that I know of.
I don't think Bill ever read in his life. I'm not sure, but I don't think he did.
But he played that legit style.
